name: web-tier

normalized_yaml:
name: web-tier
description: nightly drill of the web tier
workload:
    provider: proxmox-main
    id: "110"
backup:
    strategy: latest
restore:
    network: isolated
    timeout: 1h0m0s
startup:
    timeout: 5m0s
    wait_for_ip: true
    wait_for_agent: false
checks:
    - port: 22
      retry_interval: 5s
      timeout: 30s
      type: tcp
cleanup:
    always: true
rto_target: 5m0s
proof_summary: SERVICE, the service would be verified, the data would not
